thesis: This run focused on opening long positions on top picks from the Quality Matrix with strong composite scores and exceptional drilling results. Specifically, positions were opened on Marimaca Copper (MC2.AX) and Endeavour Mining (EDV.L). Marimaca Copper was selected for its strong copper grade of 2.2% over 424m, while Endeavour Mining was chosen for its exceptional gold grade of 278 g/t over 138m. Both companies demonstrated strong potential based on the Quality Matrix scoring.
